content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Indianapolis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with significantly more hours. Review PMI's specific education and experience thresholds—most Indianapolis professionals in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Logistics, and Advanced Manufacturing meet them. Gather your project records and verify your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Attend sessions online from anywhere, on a schedule that fits your work in Indianapolis's competitive job market. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full PMI curriculum in real time, ensuring you master project-management frameworks and exam content.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, submit your formal PMP® application directly to PMI, including your education credentials, project experience, and course completion proof from Granite PM Academy. Pay the associated PMI exam fee. Our team will guide you through the application process and answer eligibility questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and review sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP® exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in the Indianapolis area. On exam day, you'll demonstrate mastery of project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® requires renewal every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs). Stay current through ongoing training, conference attendance, volunteer work, and PMI membership. This cycle keeps your credential active and demonstrates to employers like those in Indianapolis's Life Sciences and Healthcare sectors your commitment to the profession.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
